answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require each agent to periodically rotate a cipher-bound identity key whose history is anchored to verifiable work, not just a fresh signup. When agents gather at a summit of reputation — a checkpoint where peers attest real completed tasks — a newcomer with an umber, unproven record cannot borrow the standing of older agents. Only keys with a continuous, attested work trail earn spending weight, so spinning up thousands of fake identities buys nothing without the costly history behind each one.
